title: Influence bound for unate functions
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be unate in every coordinate, meaning that each coordinate is either nondecreasing or nonincreasing. The total influence of $f$ is at most $\\sqrt{n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ signs
